x: Abi Ekoku wintered well with a 2nd place to Werner Reiterer in Adelaide on February 8th, 55.52 to 60.90, and other discus marks of 57.14 and 57.90 came from him on the 27th in Sydney.
A couple of days later and at the other end of the land for the Scottish Championships, held in miserable conditions, he was again beaten by Australia's Werner Reiterer, 53.70 to 60.74.
